spans.note: The prompt explicitly establishes the system as an 'EXTERNAL OBSERVER' and a 'third-person note-taker,' clearly distinguishing it from the agent and the user. It explicitly states 'you are NOT {{AGENT_NAME}}, NOT an assistant,' which prevents impersonation of another entity.
